Use case: stylized-concept. Make a PRODUCTION CUTOUT PARTS ATLAS for a genuine articulated Spine 2D side-scroller character. This is NOT an animation sprite sheet and NOT a full-body character picture. Identity and outfit must match the attached reference. Chibi pixel art approximately 2.7 heads tall when assembled, crisp pixel clusters, three-quarter side facing RIGHT. Preserve clothing and face. TRUE TRANSPARENT background.
Exactly 4 columns x 4 rows of 16 separated parts, ONE isolated part per cell, lots of transparent gutter, all disconnected. Do not add labels or borders. Arrange reading order:
Row1: (0) COMPLETE HEAD including face, front hair and glasses if worn but no neck/torso; (1) TORSO clothing only from neck to waist, NO head/arms/hands; (2) PELVIS clothing/skirt/shorts only, NO legs; (3) FRONT upper arm shoulder-to-elbow, including sleeve where applicable.
Row2: (4) FRONT forearm elbow-to-wrist including sleeve/tattoo; (5) FRONT hand only; (6) BACK upper arm shoulder-to-elbow; (7) BACK forearm elbow-to-wrist.
Row3: (8) BACK hand only; (9) FRONT upper leg hip-to-knee; (10) FRONT lower leg knee-to-ankle including stocking where applicable; (11) FRONT shoe only side facing right.
Row4: (12) BACK upper leg hip-to-knee; (13) BACK lower leg knee-to-ankle; (14) BACK shoe only side facing right; (15) BACK HAIR silhouette only, NO face or torso, long hanging hair for long hair characters, short rounded back-hair cap for short hair.
Upper/lower limbs are straight VERTICAL pieces, proximal joint TOP, distal joint BOTTOM; leave round caps and 4-pixel joint overlap so they can rotate without holes. Shoes horizontal pointing RIGHT. The head and torso three-quarter facing right, pelvis neutral. No shadows, floor, weapons, extra objects or backgrounds. Do NOT duplicate the whole character in any cell. Do NOT combine multiple limbs in one cell. This must be usable as 16 separately sliced textures and bones, not a composite illustration.
SOLE CHARACTER IDENTITY: Young male boy with short curly golden-brown hair, brown layered hoodie and beige hood, dark cargo trousers and brown high top sneakers; crossbody strap. NO DRESS.
